contract.immutability_basis: only the snapshot for the week the board currently stands at may be rewritten, because its games are still landing. Every earlier week is a finished record and the build refuses to touch it — a history you are allowed to edit is not a history.
contract.delta_basis: Δ week is differenced against the LATEST snapshot strictly BEFORE the current week ordinal — not against the file with the previous number, because a bye week, a cancelled Saturday or a build that did not run leaves a gap and comparing across it is still the honest comparison. The ordinal actually compared against ships beside the delta.
contract.preseason_basis: a board built before any game has been played is week ordinal 0 and is labelled Preseason. It is a real row in the history: it is what the system believed before the season answered it.
